speaker: john_heminges
text: The bag is not shut. I will not name a share while it is open.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Name it anyway. A man can dine on a figure that is a little wrong. He cannot dine on a silence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday last was six-and-thirty. I am not asking you to better it. I am asking whether tonight has a number at all.

speaker: john_heminges
text: There is a number. It is not a number I will say. When the bag is shut, I will say it. Not to please a table.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Titus went at two. Will was not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was at the board. Titus went. The bill may say what it says.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The bill is a bill. You were writing. Both of those can be true, and John still has not got a sum for us.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am not reconciling a bill and a board by inventing a sum. The— the bag is the only sum I trust, and it is not shut.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then the Rose. The bill for today is marked paid. That is a word from another house. Give it a figure and I will go home happy.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is marked paid. It is the Revels' fee. I have not got the sum. I will not write a sum I have not got.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor will I. I came from Paul's with a book I did not buy. That is not a figure either.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then the book stays on the board. I am not asking you to buy it back out of this bag.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: A book you did not buy is a purchase the purse escaped. I congratulate the escape. I still want tonight's share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, no purchase. Item, no share named. Item, we are still in the house. That is what I will enter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enter it. The king on my sheet is not a line in your book. He is two-thirds made. The parliament is not begun.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the glass? You promised me a glass. Four shillings, John said, and I have not seen one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The line is struck. If John buys one, it stays in the chest. He is not in a room where a glass can be brought. I will not break what I have not written.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Keep the glass and the parliament. Give me a number, and I will leave the king to the man who is staying out of his own scene.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You have had your dinner, or you have not. The number waits on the bag. I will not call a figure out of an open mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I go without it. I would rather a blank than a guess. A guess sits down and becomes a total if nobody contradicts it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You are as careful as John. That is a hard thing to say to a man who writes kings.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is the right thing to say on a Saturday. The reckoning stands when it stands. It does not stand in the air to be kind.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then I will not pull a number out of last week's six-and-thirty to comfort Tom. Last week was last week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Last week was six-and-thirty, and a glass promised. This week the glass is struck, and the bag is open. I can tell those two apart.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Titus went. You were not in it. The Rose is marked paid. The bag is not shut. If that is the whole of Saturday, I have heard Saturday.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is the whole I will stand beside. Go home. The share will not grow in the tiring-house for being unnamed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Send nobody after me with a guess. I have a blank sheet where a parliament would be. I would like it to stay blank, and not fill up with a sum.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It will stay blank if you leave it. I am not coming to Bishopsgate to write your parliament. I have a glass to wait for, and you have told me to wait.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then good night to the unnamed share. I will not invent it on the road.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Invention is how a book gets a total it never counted. We have not counted.
